consent.title: When you are not at the salon
consent.p1: During your shift, {{owner}} or a manager can mark when you are not at the salon. You can tap Step out when you leave and I'm back when you return.
consent.p2: If the app is open, it may check once in a while whether you are at the salon. It never asks you.
consent.p3: We only look during your shift. We keep only the times, and for a location check only inside or outside and how far. No route, no map trail.
consent.p4: {{owner}} sees the reason you give when you step out. You can see all of it under Me, My data.
